repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 局部僵肢症候群（Focal Stiff Limb Syndrome）為僵人症候群（SPS）的局部變異型，以 GAD65 自體抗體為特徵。GAD65 同時也是 T1DM 的自體抗原，此共同抗原可能是 TxGNN 知識圖譜連結的依據。然而 Glimepiride 對 GAD65 自體免疫或 GABA 能神經元功能喪失無已知直接作用，機轉連結推測性強。
SPS 的核心病理為 GAD65 自體抗體導致脊髓 GABA 能抑制功能缺失，與 T1DM 共享自體免疫背景（二者常共病）。TxGNN 可能透過共病路徑推斷此連結。Glimepiride 的 SUR1 受體結合機轉與 GABA 系統無直接聯繫，欲探索此方向需先建立體外免疫調節機轉研究。
Opsismodysplasia 為極罕見骨骼發育不良（INPPL1/SHIP2 基因突變），SHIP2 為磷脂醯肌醇磷酸酶，參與 PI3K/Akt 信號路徑（與胰島素信號下游重疊）。Glimepiride 雖可激活胰島素受體底物，但無針對骨骼形成路徑（FGF 受體信號）的已知效果，機轉連結高度推測。
硫胺素反應性功能障礙症候群（Rogers 症候群，SLC19A2 突變）引起硫胺素轉運缺陷，導致三聯症：巨球貧血、感音性聽損、糖尿病。糖尿病成分為 β 細胞功能受損，Glimepiride 理論上可短期刺激殘餘 β 細胞。然而此症的根本治療為大劑量硫胺素補充，Glimepiride 無法解決根本代謝缺陷且最終仍需胰島素治療。
藥物誘發局部脂肪萎縮常見於胰島素注射部位或其他注射藥物。Glimepiride 具部分 PPAR-γ 活性（遠弱於 Thiazolidinediones），理論上可影響脂肪細胞分化。然而 Glimepiride 本身為口服藥物，對局部注射相關脂肪萎縮的作用機轉不明確。TZDs 已有針對全身性脂肪再分配的證據，但局部脂肪萎縮的 Glimepiride 再利用無任何依據。
離心性脂肪萎縮（Centrifugal Lipodystrophy）為罕見的取得性脂肪萎縮，病因不明，可能涉及局部炎症或免疫機制。Glimepiride 與此疾病無已知機轉連結，PPAR-γ 路徑的推測性連結缺乏支持證據。
壓力誘發局部脂肪萎縮為機械性損傷所致，主要治療為消除壓力來源。Glimepiride 的藥理機轉與壓力誘發脂肪萎縮的病理（機械性缺血、局部炎症、脂肪細胞凋亡）無任何交集，再利用假說缺乏生物學基礎。
特發性局部脂肪萎縮病因不明，可能涉及局部免疫異常。Glimepiride 的 PPAR-γ 部分活性提供極弱的理論基礎，但與已有臨床證據的 Thiazolidinediones 相比，效力差距懸殊且無任何支持性研究。

clinical_trials.brief_summary: This trial will assess the safety and efficacy of omarigliptin (MK-3102) compared with the sulfonylurea, glimepiride, in Type 2 diabetes mellitus participants with inadequate glycemic control on metformin monotherapy. The primay hypothesis of the study is that after 54 weeks, the mean change from baseline in hemoglobin A1C (A1C) in participants treated with omarigliptin is non-inferior compared with that in participants treated with glimepiride.

clinical_trials.title: A Phase III, Multicenter, Double-Blind, Randomized Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of the Addition of MK-3102 Compared With the Addition of Sitagliptin in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus With Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin
clinical_trials.brief_summary: This is a non-inferiority study comparing omarigliptin with sitagliptin in participants with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) with inadequate glycemic control on metformin therapy. The primary hypothesis is that after 24 weeks, the mean change from baseline in hemoglobin A1c (A1C) in participants treated with omarigliptin is non-inferior to that in participants treated with sitagliptin. There will be a 2-week run-in period with placebo + metformin prior to the double-blind treatment period.

clinical_trials.title: The Use of Incretin-based Drugs and the Risk of Acute Pancreatitis in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
clinical_trials.brief_summary:
The purpose of this study is to determine whether incretin-based drugs (used to treat type 2 diabetes) taken either alone or in combination with other anti-diabetic drugs are associated with an increased risk of acute pancreatitis (AP) compared to other combinations of oral hypoglycemic agents (OHA).

Next to HbA1c, body weight is regarded as an important surrogate end-point in trials investigating glucose-lowering agents. An increase in weight could contribute to worsening insulin resistance. Differences in weight after starting glucose lowering agents have been described in many randomized controlled trials (RCTs).

clinical_trials.title: A Comparative Study to Assess the Effect of Vildagliptin Versus Glimepiride on Glucose Variability in Type 2 Diabetic Patients Uncontrolled on Metformin Alone
clinical_trials.brief_summary: Compare the effect of Vildagliptin plus Metformin versus Glimepiride plus Metformin on glucose variability in T2DM patients.

clinical_trials.title: Effect of Inhaled Pre-Prandial Human Insulin Plus Metformin & Glimepiride Versus Rosiglitazone Plus Metformin & Glimepiride on HbA1c in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes
clinical_trials.brief_summary: This trial is conducted in the United States of America (USA). This trial will compare the changes in HbA1c after 26 weeks of inhaled insulin or rosiglitazone treatment, both in combination with metformin and glimepiride.

clinical_trials.title: Therapeutic Efficacy of Triple Combination of Metformin, DPP4 Inhibitor and Thiazolidinedione in Drug-naïve Korean Type 2 Diabetic Patients
clinical_trials.brief_summary: Triple combination of metformin, DPP4 inhibitor and Thiazolidinedione would be a good option in the treatment of drug-naïve Korean type 2 diabetic patients.

clinical_trials.title: A Randomized, Controlled Trial Comparing the Effect of Exenatide, Sitagliptin or Glimepiride on Functional ß -Cell Mass in Patients With Impaired Fasting Glucose or Early Type 2 Diabetes
clinical_trials.brief_summary: This study evaluates exenatide, sitagliptin, and glimepiride for the treatment of high blood sugar in patients with impaired fasting glucose or early type 2 diabetes. The purpose of this study is to determine if exenatide and sitagliptin increase the amount of insulin made by the pancreas compared to glimepiride. It is hypothesized that exenatide or sitagliptin will sustain or increase the amount of insulin made by the pancreas in comparison to glimepiride.

clinical_trials.title: An Individualized treatMent aPproach for oldER patIents: A Randomized, Controlled stUdy in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (IMPERIUM)
clinical_trials.brief_summary: The main purpose of this study is to compare the benefits and risks associated with the use of 2 treatment strategies to lower blood sugar in participants aged 65 and older with T2DM. One strategy is based on the use of oral and injectable medications that only reduce blood sugar (glucose) when it is high. The other strategy is based on non-glucose dependent agents. The trial will last up to 72 weeks for each participant.

clinical_trials.title: The Comparative Study of Dipeptidyl Peptidase-IV Inhibitor and Sulfonylurea on the Effect of Improving Glucose Variability and Oxidative Stress in Type 2 Diabetic Patients With Inadequate Glycemic Control on Metformin

literature.abstract: The purpose of this study was to review studies reporting on quality of life and treatment satisfaction of patients with diabetes mellitus being treated with long-acting insulin analogues.

A novel mutation in the ABCC8 gene causing maturity-onset diabetes of the young: A case report.
literature.abstract: A 34-year-old woman was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes mellitus and treated with insulin for 24 years. The patient has a family history of diabetes in three consecutive generations. Her Whole exon sequencing showed a heterozygous mutation in the ABCC8 gene, and it also found some of her relatives to carry this mutation. She was diagnosed with MODY12 and received glimepiride therapy with the achievement of good glycaemic control.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Glimepiride 透過結合 SUR1 受體關閉 K-ATP 通道促進胰島素分泌，機轉依賴功能性 β 細胞；T1DM 中 β 細胞因自體免疫破壞，主路徑失效。然而 BB 大鼠研究（PMID 7475982, 8539908）顯示 Glimepiride 具免疫調節效果，可延緩或預防自體免疫性糖尿病發病，另有部分 PPAR-γ 活性及胰島素受體磷酸化效果。機轉相關性為間接/弱。
